title: Mukhtasar Khalil
author: khalil-ibn-ishaq
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Khalil's compressed statement of the authoritative Maliki position on every question, written in a deliberately dense style in which each word carries a ruling. It became the central text of Maliki law across North and West Africa.
historicalContext: Khalil ibn Ishaq al-Jundi taught in Cairo and spent some twenty-five years on the work. Its compression called forth hundreds of commentaries, and French colonial jurists translated it as the code of Maliki law in Algeria.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
